baseline_regression: Real long-press on formatted assistant text did not open selection before restoration.
restoration: Two per-message body-only SelectionContainer scopes, matching v28 assistant response and translation structure.
covered: Formatted assistant text, range handles, handle dragging, copy and select-all
Markdown blocks and fenced code within one message
Horizontal code scrolling and vertical long-answer scrolling
Translation text excludes its header, hide action and original message
User reaction, attachments, neighboring messages and proactive suggestions excluded
Ordinary link taps preserved; rendered link text included in select-all
Active message selection yields to composer focus; draft retained; 1px-drift send remains reachable
Injected IME insets lift composer without claiming physical keyboard validation
known_existing_behavior: Compose 1.9 long-press directly on a link label may both select it and trigger its link callback. Identical fresh-state behavior confirmed on the unchanged user-message wrapper. No gesture/library rewrite included.
host_limits: Robolectric SDK 34 native rendering; not a physical Android phone
Toolbar presentation and magnifier replaced in tests; Foundation gesture recognition, range handles and clipboard callbacks are real
Activity-root captures exclude separate popup handles and toolbar
Development APKs are unsigned/debuggable and do not establish original-signature update compatibility.

test_fixture_stabilization: Bounded synchronization with the new task menu and its first-row position; no task product changes or assertions removed.
status: Validated in host; no partial APK delivery
visual_review: Six native host captures independently reviewed: light/dark, normal/large type, selected text, focused composer and simulated IME insets. No visual blocker.
